title: Fidgety Feet, Tiger Rag themes and the Dixieland Jazz Band's New York debut
summary: He explains where his tunes' ideas came from and recounts opening in New York in 1917, claiming priority over the Creole band and criticizing Stearns and Souchon.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
